imp_dos.quote: Because base amounts are denominated in base tokens and quote amounts in quote tokens, equality is virtually impossible, so every trade relies on the bit-wise clause. Random bit patterns therefore decide whether normal trades succeed or fail, enabling denial-of-service on any pair of amounts with disjoint bits.
High – attacker can systematically revert genuine matches, effectively freezing order execution and denying service.
